verdict.rationale: The dots docs say a dot can read documents through a Google Drive connection and can work with local files once your computer is connected. It also implies a dot can reason over drafts you share with it. That is only a thin, indirect form of document access, not a documented upload-and-analyze feature. Missing for 10: an explicit file upload flow, named support for spreadsheets and PDFs, documented analysis of file contents, and independent or hands-on evidence of analysis accuracy.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can upload documents, spreadsheets, and PDFs and get accurate analysis of their contents
